chapter: Will Marion Cook and the Southern Syncopated Orchestra
title: Cook as a leader who conducted with facial expressions
summary: Cook was a good solid leader who trained the players to read the effects from his face and slight movements.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: I hope so. Well, how was he to work for, Will Marion Cook?
You see, he trained musicians -- a real orchestra, the different effects were
written on his face. His facial expressions. The effects, you see.
He directed the orchestra with facial expressions, and slight movements of his anatomy.
That's very interesting. In other words, how would he do that? How would he direct with his face?
With his face, you can see -- I mean, the orchestra, we more or less were looking at him, most of the time, because the parts we almost know by heart, you see.
And we can see the embellishments that he wants from his face. His emotions -- he's very emotional.
Slight movements with his hands, but his facial emotions.
He'd give you kind of a sad look when he wanted --
Yes, yes. But he was really -- I think that he was unique, I never seen anyone else like him.
